description: Introduction posts in POAScan's LabLeak mirror that share one text template (masked 4 word shingles, Jaccard at least 0.6, groups of 10 or more): per group posts, authors, first_ts, last_ts, span_s, median_gap_s, per_hour, authors_with_join and authors_with_answer. Aggregate counts and timing only; no author is named and no post is quoted. Use it to see how many intros came from one template and when.
name: get_intro_templates
title: Intro posts sharing a template
